release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1228-7 is a longer-focal-length (6.9 mm thermal) bi-spectrum turret fusing a 256x192 thermal module with a 5 MP optical channel, driven by the GUANLAN AI model for extended-range perimeter protection with IR and white light up to 60 m. It adds fire-point and smoking detection and temperature exception alarms (-20 to 150 C).

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
